notes: first day of the daily series; prev_anchor is the one-time genesis root over all earlier records (see /v1/anchor/genesis)

rules.leaf: sha256 of the canonical JSON (keys sorted, no whitespace, sig included) of each signed record whose own timestamp falls in this UTC day; for the bulk probe archives, of the signed daily manifest, which holds the sha256 of every archive part
rules.tree: RFC 6962 Merkle tree hash over the 32-byte leaf hashes: leaf node sha256(0x00||h), inner node sha256(0x01||left||right); empty tree = sha256 of empty input
rules.anchor: sha256 of canonical JSON {v, day, leaf_count, merkle_root, prev_anchor}; prev_anchor is the previous day's anchor, or the genesis anchor for the first day of the series

opentimestamps.status: submitted to calendars; Bitcoin confirmation pending (upgraded copies live in the public repo)
